reference_sql:
WITH customer_orders AS (
  -- one row per known customer with at least one order in 2025
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         DATE '2025-12-31' - MAX(CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)) AS recency_days,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
scores AS (
  -- one row per customer, with its R, F and M scores
  SELECT customer_id, recency_days, revenue_eur,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days DESC, customer_id) AS r_score,
         CASE WHEN n_orders >= 6 THEN 5
              WHEN n_orders >= 4 THEN 4
              WHEN n_orders = 3 THEN 3
              WHEN n_orders = 2 THEN 2
              ELSE 1 END AS f_score,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_eur, customer_id) AS m_score
  FROM customer_orders
),
segments AS (
  -- one row per customer, with its segment
  SELECT customer_id, recency_days, revenue_eur,
         CASE WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score >= 4 AND m_score >= 4 THEN 'champions'
              WHEN f_score >= 4 THEN 'loyal'
              WHEN r_score <= 2 AND f_score >= 3 THEN 'at_risk'
              WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score = 1 THEN 'new'
              WHEN r_score <= 2 THEN 'hibernating'
              ELSE 'others' END AS segment
  FROM scores
)
-- one row per segment
SELECT segment,
       COUNT(*) AS n_customers,
       SUM(revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 1) AS avg_recency_days,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revenue_eur) / SUM(SUM(revenue_eur)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment

WITH customer_orders AS (
  -- one row per known customer with at least one order in 2025
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         date_diff('day', MAX(CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)), DATE '2025-12-31') AS recency_days,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
scores AS (
  -- one row per customer, with its R, F and M scores
  SELECT customer_id, recency_days, revenue_eur,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days DESC, customer_id ASC) AS r_score,
         CASE WHEN n_orders = 1 THEN 1
              WHEN n_orders = 2 THEN 2
              WHEN n_orders = 3 THEN 3
              WHEN n_orders <= 5 THEN 4
              ELSE 5 END AS f_score,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_eur ASC, customer_id ASC) AS m_score
  FROM customer_orders
),
segments AS (
  -- one row per customer, with its segment
  SELECT recency_days, revenue_eur,
         CASE WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score >= 4 AND m_score >= 4 THEN 'champions'
              WHEN f_score >= 4 THEN 'loyal'
              WHEN r_score <= 2 AND f_score >= 3 THEN 'at_risk'
              WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score = 1 THEN 'new'
              WHEN r_score <= 2 THEN 'hibernating'
              ELSE 'others' END AS segment
  FROM scores
),
segment_totals AS (
  -- one row per segment
  SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS n_customers, SUM(revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, AVG(recency_days) AS avg_recency_days
  FROM segments
  GROUP BY segment
),
grand_total AS (
  -- one row: the revenue of every scored customer
  SELECT SUM(revenue_eur) AS total_eur
  FROM segments
)
SELECT st.segment, st.n_customers, st.revenue_eur,
       ROUND(st.avg_recency_days, 1) AS avg_recency_days,
       ROUND(100.0 * st.revenue_eur / g.total_eur, 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM segment_totals AS st
CROSS JOIN grand_total AS g
ORDER BY st.segment

solver.query:
WITH cust AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)), DATE '2025-12-31') AS recency,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS freq,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
), sc AS (
  SELECT *,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency DESC, customer_id ASC) AS r,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY revenue ASC, customer_id ASC) AS m,
    CASE WHEN freq = 1 THEN 1 WHEN freq = 2 THEN 2 WHEN freq = 3 THEN 3 WHEN freq <= 5 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS f
  FROM cust
), seg AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN r >= 4 AND f >= 4 AND m >= 4 THEN 'champions'
         WHEN f >= 4 THEN 'loyal'
         WHEN r <= 2 AND f >= 3 THEN 'at_risk'
         WHEN r >= 4 AND f = 1 THEN 'new'
         WHEN r <= 2 THEN 'hibernating'
         ELSE 'others' END AS segment
  FROM sc
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS n_customers, SUM(revenue) AS revenue_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(recency), 1) AS avg_recency_days,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revenue) / SUM(SUM(revenue)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM seg
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment ASC
